subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Summery: Neela chose two tours. They were the Night Safari and a boat journey. She enjoyed both the tours very much. She was charmed at the activities of the animals. She saw the tigers and hyenas feasting on their kills. She spent the busy day but she enjoyed herself. On the boat trip, she had a free meal. Twenty different Singaporean foods were served at a self- service lunch. Neela did not know how to start. An old lady helped her. She tested quite a number of different items. At last, she had a tea with lightly cooked dishes. Neela bore the journey in her memory forever.
